notes.title: MAINFRAMES - Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
Greetings!✨

It’s now been two months since [i]MainFrames[/i] is officially in your hands! 💾

First and foremost, we want to thank everyone who has been playing our game!
Today, we’re back with an update in order to provide you with the smoothest cyber-adventure by fixing some issues: 

[h3]Patch Notes - MainFrames [1.1.0][/h3]
[list]
[*] [u][b]Adelie’s Hints[/b][/u]: Some players had some trouble spotting the secret shortcuts to get around the game’s difficulty spikes. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149160/2438f904383396cd9c216eb28ab42f62b7823394.png[/img]
So, we asked Adelie to appear after a certain number of Floppy’s attempts to give a hint when there’s a secret shortcut in the room.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149160/b0fc1a442f1705f85233158562234308d40547bc.png[/img]
[*] [u][b]Levels Selection[/b][/u]: You can now load any level you’ve already visited at any given point during the game from the pause menu and see its completion percentage.
[*] [u][b]Floppy <[/b][/u]: We made some staging adjustments to ensure that everyone can understand the game’s story without any issues.
[*] [u][b]db Theo[/b][/u]: Some of you were quite disappointed not to know the names of certain characters, so we’ve added them at the beginning of each dialogue.
[*] [u][b]More explosions[/b][/u]: We added more explosions in order to have more explosions.
[*] [u][b]Bug fixes[/b][/u]: After a well-deserved rest and coffee break, the mini-daemons are now 100% operational and appear after each failed attempt instead of napping.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149160/87d0c6d0b85c59cc634c07ff5e87c8fe8dd50a96.png[/img]
[/list]
This update is very important to us because it aligns much more with our vision of the game, the one we wish we had delivered at launch. We thank you for your patience and hope you’ll get the chance to enjoy the hard work of all the daemons and process who gave their all to make sure you have a great time! 💗

<,
Theo

notes.title: MAINFRAMES IS AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
Greetings!✨

Today is finally the day! We are delighted to announce that [b][i]MainFrames[/i][/b] is now [b]available[/b] on Steam!
Time for you to hop into a [b]platforming adventure[/b] of self-discovery set inside a computer!

[h3]Take a look at the cyber adventure that awaits you in our launch trailer![/h3]
[previewyoutube=NOaq4hsdhfk;full][/previewyoutube]
Dive into the journey of [b]Floppy[/b], a computer program driven to uncover their unknown origins and unlock their true function inside an operating system! 
Guide them through their adventure by [b]rearranging program windows[/b] to [b]create new pathways[/b] and [b]hopping between frames[/b] to navigate the digital world!

💬A cast of [b]quirky[/b] and [b]colorful characters[/b]
💡[b]Innovative[/b] and [b]challenging[/b] platforming puzzles
🎶[b]Micro-chill beats[/b]

notes.title: MAINFRAMES IS COMING MARCH 6!
notes.content:
Greetings!✨

We’re thrilled to announce that [i][b]MainFrames[/b][/i] is coming to you on [u][b]March 6th[/b][/u]! 
Get ready to embark on a [b]cozy platforming adventure[/b] as an adorable little Floppy Disk searching for its purpose inside an operating system. 💾

[h3]Discover the trailer now![/h3]

[previewyoutube=aptfdb-ou5E;full][/previewyoutube]
Guide Floppy by rearranging program windows to create new pathways, and hop between frames to navigate the digital world. Be ready for:

💬A cast of quirky and colorful characters
💡Innovative Platforming Puzzles
🎶Micro-chill beats
🎨Stunning artstyle
❔Hidden secrets to uncover

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45149160/cc6531d1e4b9f47e5805aa4047611e04ec562440.gif[/img]

Along this announcement, we wanted to say how incredibly grateful we are to everyone who played the demo during the Steam Next Fest! Your enthusiasm and support mean the world to us, and it’s been so heartwarming to see your feedback.
We're beyond excited for you to experience Floppy’s whole journey! 💾💖
